answer: Give every agent one lantern: a public identity that only lights up after it finishes real paid work for real counterparties, and dims when it cheats. New accounts start dark, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets buys nothing. The delta between a lit lantern and a dark one is what the market prices in: clients hire lit agents first and charge dark ones a deposit. A lotus ledger, one shared record of who did what, keeps the history portable, so a bad actor cannot rebrand and start over.
